# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

[Henry Schein Cares]

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]

  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

# Tailored pharmacokinetics, enhanced safety.

Reimagine what’s possible.

**WE ARE ARx.** Your drug delivery partner for what’s next.

Achieve next-generation absorption, precision and control while keeping the patient experience front
and center, with ARx. Your established partner in oral thin film and transdermal delivery systems.

[ Partner With Us ][49]

### Therapeutic Thin Film

Our oral thin films provide a convenient, easy-to-use platform for fast-acting, immediate-release
therapies that bypass first-pass metabolism. These dissolvable strips deliver medication directly
into the bloodstream through the oral mucosa, ensuring faster absorption, fewer side effects and a
more comfortable patient experience.
* Quick and precise drug delivery.
* Convenient design that eliminates swallowing difficulties.
* Customizable profiles for tailored therapeutic experiences.
* Improved bioavailability.
* Taste-masking options in various flavors.
* Easy transport and discreet administration.

[ Dosage Forms ][50]

### Transdermal Patches

Our transdermal patches deliver medication through a controlled-release system that penetrates the
skin and directly enters the bloodstream. By bypassing the digestive system and liver, they maintain
consistent drug levels, reducing the need for frequent doses and minimizing side effects.
* Non-invasive application for ease of use.
* Controlled release for consistent therapeutic levels.
* Avoidance of side effects from peaks and troughs of serum levels.
* Versatile options tailored for localized or systemic needs.
* Long-lasting wear reduces the frequency of dosing.
* Avoids first-pass metabolism and potential for GI side effects.

[ Dosage Forms ][51]

## Technologies

Our innovative technology platforms are designed to deliver better absorption and bioavailability
while improving the experience for patients.
**This includes MicroDEP, our breakthrough, patented method for rapid-onset delivery of ultra-low
doses through an oral thin film. **
* Precise dosing with as little as five micrograms.
* Fast absorption for quick onset of effects.
* Micro-sized deposits for targeted delivery.
* Enhanced bioavailability bypasses the digestive system.
* Customizable formulations for various APIs and needs.

## Who We Are

ARx specializes in developing novel, innovative drug delivery systems that improve control of drug
release and absorption, bioavailability, as well as patient experience and safety, expanding
therapeutic potential and redefining what’s possible for patients. As one of the first pioneers in
film and adhesive polymer science and novel dosing strategies, we’ve helped shape modern drug
delivery through higher standards for quality, safety and efficacy.

ARx supports every stage of the drug development lifecycle. From formulation to commercial
manufacturing, we expedite timelines and improve patient outcomes with an eye for optimizing safety
and effectiveness.

We accelerate filing and commercialization processes with scalable manufacturing. Using QbD
principles, we optimize production with yields and regulatory approval in mind.

**Commercial Manufacturing**

ARx produces over 100 million units annually in FDA-registered cGMP facilities. We guarantee a
reliable supply of high-quality films and patches from launch through ongoing production.

**Quality Management**

Quality comes first. At ARx, we prioritize transparency and QC, ensuring compliance at each stage in
your development process.

**Analytical Testing**

Every ARx product is driven by advancing patient health. We thoroughly test formulations on-site to
ensure they meet product specifications and the highest clinical standards.

## Therapeutic Areas

Patients with complex conditions need drug delivery systems that are precise, customized, and
adaptable. Standard methods often fail to provide consistent dosing, improved absorption, and
sustained effects. ARx designs tailored delivery systems that improve drug bioavailability while
avoiding first-pass metabolism and accommodating complex conditions to improve patient quality of
life.

Our solutions cover the following therapeutic areas:
* Parkinson's
* Alzheimer’s
* Cancer
* Opioid Addiction
* Chronic Pain
* Obesity

### Parkinson's Disease

Controlled-release systems provide reliable, consistent dosing, helping patients manage Parkinson's
disease more effectively while supporting better adherence and quality of life.

### Alzheimer’s Disease

Alternative delivery methods ensure steady absorption and consistent dosing, supporting long-term
management of Alzheimer’s disease and cognitive function.

### Cancer

Controlled, consistent drug delivery reduces dosing frequency and side effects, improving comfort
for cancer patients throughout treatment.

### Opioid Addiction

Alternative dosing systems enhance adherence and provide steady medication delivery, supporting
recovery and reducing the risk of relapse.

### Chronic Pain

Transdermal patches and oral thin films provide reliable pain relief, reducing dosing frequency and
minimizing side effects, making chronic pain management more manageable.

### Obesity

Oral thin films and transdermal patches offer discreet, easy-to-use delivery options, helping
patients with obesity manage their treatment and improve adherence.

without affecting the property and nature of the end product. Almost all enzymes are proteins, but
not all proteins are enzymes.

reaction. Enzyme activity can be influenced by a change in pH, temperature, and the concentration of
substrate present and can be described by the Turnover Number. Our range of Enzymes that are

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Today, We Are

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons

### About Conference



After a successful conference of Pharmaceutica 2025, Pharma Conferences team cordially invites
participants from all over the world to attend **"27^{th} International Conference and Exhibition on
Pharmaceutics & Novel Drug Delivery Systems" **slated on August 20-21, 2026 in London, UK .
This [Pharmaceutics Conference][82] includes a wide range of Keynote presentations, Oral talks,
Poster presentations, Symposia, Workshops, Exhibitions and Career development programs.

[Novel drug delivery systems Conference][83] is one of the well-established conference
among [Pharmaceutical Conferences][84] organized by Conference Series

Pharmaceutica 2026 covers various aspects of Bio-Pharmaceutics, [Pharmaceutical Chemistry][85], Drug
Targeting and Design, Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics in Drugs, Pharmaceutical Formulation,
Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Pharmaceutical Nanotechnology, [Novel Drug Delivery Systems][86],
Smart Drug Delivery Systems, [Nano medicine][87] and Biomedical Applications, Biomaterials in Drug
Delivery, Vaccine Drug Delivery Systems, Medical Devices for [Drug Delivery][88], Biologics
& [Biosimilars][89], Pharmaceutical Analysis, Pharmaceutical Process Validation, Pharmaceutical
Packaging, [Clinical Trials][90] and [Clinical Research][91], Pharmacogenetics and Genomics,
Regulatory Affairs and Intellectual Property Rights, Industrial and Physical Pharmacy, Clinical and
Hospital Pharmacy, [Pharmacovigilance][92] and Drug Safety, Pharmacy Education and Practice

**2026 Highlights:**
* 200+ Participation (70% Industry: 30% Academia)
* 9+ Keynote Speakers
* 30+ Plenary Speakers
* 3+ Exhibitors
* 14 Innovative Educational Sessions
* B2B Meetings

# Revolutionizing Drug Delivery Through **Oral Film Technology**

At Nualtis, we leverage science and innovation to improve quality of life. We develop and
manufacture innovative oral thin films to create novel and impactful treatments.

[Contact Us][17]Contact Us
Contact Us
Trusted by

Our Oral Film Technology offers **significant advantages**

Our proprietary film technologies offer significant benefits over traditional dosage forms, creating
better experiences for patients and improved treatment outcome.

Enhanced Bioavailability

Our oral films deliver medications directly through the mucosal lining. This results in faster onset
of action, reduced dosage requirements, and minimized side effects compared to conventional tablets
or capsules.

Systemic Absorption

Intimate and prolonged contact with the oral mucosa allows for systemic absorption of the drug,
thereby reducing first-pass metabolism and limiting stomach exposure. This opens up an oral path of
administration for drugs that cannot be given as a tablet or capsule.

Precision Dosing

The innovative delivery method allows for precise control of drug release rates, enabling customized
therapeutic profiles and reduced dosing frequency for improved patient convenience.

Patient-Friendly Design

Nualtis films dissolve rapidly in the mouth without water, making medication administration easier.
They are easy to carry, discreet, with a pleasant taste. Especially for pediatric patients,
geriatric populations, animals, and those with swallowing difficulties the convenient format
improves treatment adherence.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

# To be the leader in innovative drug delivery solutions that transform patient experiences through
# improved convenience and better treatment adherence.

**Making Quality Healthcare Affordable Through Drug Delivery Solutions Focusing On Patient
Convenience and Adherence**

Zim Innovation
Who we are
What we do
How we help you

# An Innovative Pharmaceutical Manufacturer in India

We are a research-driven pharmaceutical company based in India that develops, manufactures, and
supplies differentiated generic products in the oral solid dosage forms, both as pre-formulation
intermediates as well as finished formulations for certain key therapeutic segments. As a vertically
integrated pharmaceutical manufacturer, we offer both pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products.

We have in-house R&D capabilities to offer a range of non-infringing drug delivery solutions based
on process technologies that enable patient compliance thereby reducing the cost of treatment.

[
Know More
[Know More]][72]

# We develop complex generic products & novel drug delivery techniques

We provide a comprehensive range of solutions in India and across the globe from a pharmaceutical
manufacturer, including product conceptualization, development, BE studies, regulatory support for
dossier preparation and submission, product registrations, manufacturing, and supply.

Our offerings encompass differentiated generic products in the form of finished formulations and
pre-formulation intermediates, such as granules, pellets (immediate-release, modified-release,
delayed-release, etc.), taste-masked powders, dry suspensions, tablets, capsules, and Oral Thin
Films (OTF).

[
Know More
[Know More]][73]

# We help our partners gain market-share with our cutting-edge technology

As an experienced pharmaceutical manufacturer,  ZIM Labs uses its proprietary knowledge, technology
and manufacturing process expertise to bridge the technology gap in Regulated, Pharmerging and ROW
markets while assisting local players in various geographies to launch differentiated /combination
generic products to compete in their respective local markets.

[
Know More
[Know More]][74]

## Products

# Technology Based Products

We are a pharmaceutical products manufacturing company, innovating in novel drug delivery solutions,
leveraging cutting-edge technology to deliver maximum benefits to our clients. Backed by an expert
R&D team and state-of-the-art facilities, our vision is to provide niche, affordable, and
high-quality healthcare solutions that ensure patient convenience and adherence.

## The workout that works out well.

Orangetheory combines full-body strength training with heart-pumping cardio to help you build
strength now, while laying the foundation for long-term health.

In weeks, most members notice the shift: more energy, a better mood, and real momentum. On average,
members lose **8.6% body fat** and gain **2.6% lean muscle** from 18 classes in just 8 weeks.¹ That
kind of progress is why millions of members across 1,500 studios worldwide have chosen Orangetheory
to achieve their fitness goals.

Not your thing after 30 days? No sweat—we’ll refund your money.^{†}

[Woman running on a treadmill.]
[Woman doing a low row with a dumbbell, guided by a coach.]

## More personalized. Less pressure.

You don’t need to be fit to get started. Just show up—we’ve got you. With expert coaching and
OTconnect™ technology, every workout adjusts to your fitness level and your goals. Whether you’re
easing in or pushing hard, we meet you with encouragement and support—not pressure. Every step
forward builds a body—and mindset—that’s stronger than yesterday.

[Learn more about the workout.][39]

## best Services & Products

## What we bring to you

Salvavidas Pharma is a well-known Indian pharmaceutical exporter that provides a wide variety of
medications to international markets. The organization, which is based in Surat, Gujarat, is one of
the greatest places to find pharmaceutical items. It provides a wide range of products that are
developed to fulfill the requirements of its customers, such as antimalarials, analgesics, and
antibiotics. Salvavidas Pharma, which has a large worldwide presence, focuses on public health as a
driver for social and economic advancement. It is currently one of the leading pharmaceutical firms
in India.

PILOT RUN FAQ

## Start small.
## Learn fast.

### Can I start with a 500-box pilot run?

Yes. Qualified projects can begin with a 500-box pilot, depending on the formula, strip count,
packaging, and production setup. The goal is to validate the product before committing to scale.

### How many strips does that mean?

Five hundred 20-count boxes equal 10,000 strips. Five hundred 30-count boxes equal 15,000 strips. We
show both box and strip quantities in the project brief so the first run is easy to picture.

### Private label or custom?

Private label is the faster route when a proven concept fits. Custom development makes sense when
the active, dose, flavor, or product experience needs to be unique.

### What happens after I send a project brief?

We review formula feasibility, target box count, packaging, testing, timing, and the most practical
route to a qualified pilot run.

### What are oral dissolving films also called?

Depending on intended use, buyers may use oral dissolving film (ODF), oral thin film (OTF),
mouth-dissolving strip, fast-dissolving strip, sublingual film, buccal film, melt-in-mouth strip, or
orally disintegrating film. The intended route and product claims must be confirmed for each
project.

### Is an oral film manufacturer the same as an OEM, CMO, or CDMO?

OEM, CMO, and CDMO describe different possible development and manufacturing scopes. StripWorks
supports brand-owned private-label and custom contract manufacturing projects, with formulation,
testing, packaging, documentation, and regulatory responsibilities confirmed in writing for each
project.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

FAQ

## Common questions.

Who can apply?

We work with clinics, practitioners, wellness brands, and qualified businesses. Every application is
reviewed for eligibility and program fit.

What product lines are available?

Once approved, you can access oral dissolving films, sterile compounds, and select regenerative
programs. Availability varies by account type and program eligibility.

Can I sell under my own brand?

Yes — private-label and clinic-branded options are available across select product lines. We handle
production and packaging; you get finished product under your brand.

How fast do orders ship?

In-stock orders placed before 12pm PST ship the same day. Cryo-shipping is available for select
regenerative programs. Track every shipment from your dashboard.

Do you offer custom formulations?

Yes — for oral dissolving films, we offer custom formulation services with our in-house cGMP
facility. Reach out through your portal once approved to discuss options.

What documentation is provided?

Documentation is available by program and account type. Details are provided during onboarding and
accessible through your private portal.

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

# Tailored pharmacokinetics, enhanced safety.

Reimagine what’s possible.

**WE ARE ARx.** Your drug delivery partner for what’s next.

Achieve next-generation absorption, precision and control while keeping the patient experience front
and center, with ARx. Your established partner in oral thin film and transdermal delivery systems.

[ Partner With Us ][49]

### Therapeutic Thin Film

Our oral thin films provide a convenient, easy-to-use platform for fast-acting, immediate-release
therapies that bypass first-pass metabolism. These dissolvable strips deliver medication directly
into the bloodstream through the oral mucosa, ensuring faster absorption, fewer side effects and a
more comfortable patient experience.
* Quick and precise drug delivery.
* Convenient design that eliminates swallowing difficulties.
* Customizable profiles for tailored therapeutic experiences.
* Improved bioavailability.
* Taste-masking options in various flavors.
* Easy transport and discreet administration.

[ Dosage Forms ][50]

### Transdermal Patches

Our transdermal patches deliver medication through a controlled-release system that penetrates the
skin and directly enters the bloodstream. By bypassing the digestive system and liver, they maintain
consistent drug levels, reducing the need for frequent doses and minimizing side effects.
* Non-invasive application for ease of use.
* Controlled release for consistent therapeutic levels.
* Avoidance of side effects from peaks and troughs of serum levels.
* Versatile options tailored for localized or systemic needs.
* Long-lasting wear reduces the frequency of dosing.
* Avoids first-pass metabolism and potential for GI side effects.

[ Dosage Forms ][51]

## Technologies

Our innovative technology platforms are designed to deliver better absorption and bioavailability
while improving the experience for patients.
**This includes MicroDEP, our breakthrough, patented method for rapid-onset delivery of ultra-low
doses through an oral thin film. **
* Precise dosing with as little as five micrograms.
* Fast absorption for quick onset of effects.
* Micro-sized deposits for targeted delivery.
* Enhanced bioavailability bypasses the digestive system.
* Customizable formulations for various APIs and needs.

[ All Technologies ][53]

## Who We Are

ARx specializes in developing novel, innovative drug delivery systems that improve control of drug
release and absorption, bioavailability, as well as patient experience and safety, expanding
therapeutic potential and redefining what’s possible for patients. As one of the first pioneers in
film and adhesive polymer science and novel dosing strategies, we’ve helped shape modern drug
delivery through higher standards for quality, safety and efficacy.

[ ABOUT ARx ][54]

## Product Development & Commercialization

ARx supports every stage of the drug development lifecycle. From formulation to commercial
manufacturing, we expedite timelines and improve patient outcomes with an eye for optimizing safety
and effectiveness.

**Process Development**

We accelerate filing and commercialization processes with scalable manufacturing. Using QbD
principles, we optimize production with yields and regulatory approval in mind.

**Commercial Manufacturing**

ARx produces over 100 million units annually in FDA-registered cGMP facilities. We guarantee a
reliable supply of high-quality films and patches from launch through ongoing production.

**Quality Management**

Quality comes first. At ARx, we prioritize transparency and QC, ensuring compliance at each stage in
your development process.

**Analytical Testing**

Every ARx product is driven by advancing patient health. We thoroughly test formulations on-site to
ensure they meet product specifications and the highest clinical standards.

## Therapeutic Areas

Patients with complex conditions need drug delivery systems that are precise, customized, and

sustained effects. ARx designs tailored delivery systems that improve drug bioavailability while
avoiding first-pass metabolism and accommodating complex conditions to improve patient quality of
life.

* Parkinson's
* Alzheimer’s
* Cancer
* Opioid Addiction
* Chronic Pain
* Obesity

### Parkinson's Disease

Controlled-release systems provide reliable, consistent dosing, helping patients manage Parkinson's
disease more effectively while supporting better adherence and quality of life.

### Alzheimer’s Disease

Alternative delivery methods ensure steady absorption and consistent dosing, supporting long-term
management of Alzheimer’s disease and cognitive function.

### Cancer

Controlled, consistent drug delivery reduces dosing frequency and side effects, improving comfort
for cancer patients throughout treatment.

### Opioid Addiction

Alternative dosing systems enhance adherence and provide steady medication delivery, supporting
recovery and reducing the risk of relapse.

### Chronic Pain

Transdermal patches and oral thin films provide reliable pain relief, reducing dosing frequency and
minimizing side effects, making chronic pain management more manageable.

### Obesity

Oral thin films and transdermal patches offer discreet, easy-to-use delivery options, helping
patients with obesity manage their treatment and improve adherence.

window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

## The Minds BehindMarket Intelligence

At M2Square, we don’t just study markets — we decode them. Founded in 2023, we are a dynamic market
research and business intelligence firm empowering organizations to make smarter, faster, and
data-driven decisions. Our expertise spans across diverse industries, helping clients navigate
complex markets, identify emerging opportunities, and stay ahead of evolving consumer and business
trends.

With a team of passionate researchers, analysts, and strategists, we turn numbers into narratives
and insights into action. Whether it’s understanding market shifts, measuring brand performance, or
exploring the next big trend — M2Square delivers clarity where it matters most.

Because in a world driven by change, insight is your greatest advantage.

After a successful conference of Pharmaceutica 2025, Pharma Conferences team cordially invites
participants from all over the world to attend **"27^{th} International Conference and Exhibition on
Pharmaceutics & Novel Drug Delivery Systems" **slated on August 20-21, 2026 in London, UK .

Poster presentations, Symposia, Workshops, Exhibitions and Career development programs.

among [Pharmaceutical Conferences][84] organized by Conference Series

& [Biosimilars][89], Pharmaceutical Analysis, Pharmaceutical Process Validation, Pharmaceutical
Packaging, [Clinical Trials][90] and [Clinical Research][91], Pharmacogenetics and Genomics,
Regulatory Affairs and Intellectual Property Rights, Industrial and Physical Pharmacy, Clinical and
Hospital Pharmacy, [Pharmacovigilance][92] and Drug Safety, Pharmacy Education and Practice

# Revolutionizing Drug Delivery Through **Oral Film Technology**

At Nualtis, we leverage science and innovation to improve quality of life. We develop and
manufacture innovative oral thin films to create novel and impactful treatments.

[Contact Us][17]Contact Us
Contact Us
Trusted by

Our Oral Film Technology offers **significant advantages**

Our proprietary film technologies offer significant benefits over traditional dosage forms, creating
better experiences for patients and improved treatment outcome.

Enhanced Bioavailability

Our oral films deliver medications directly through the mucosal lining. This results in faster onset
of action, reduced dosage requirements, and minimized side effects compared to conventional tablets
or capsules.

Systemic Absorption

Intimate and prolonged contact with the oral mucosa allows for systemic absorption of the drug,
thereby reducing first-pass metabolism and limiting stomach exposure. This opens up an oral path of
administration for drugs that cannot be given as a tablet or capsule.

Precision Dosing

The innovative delivery method allows for precise control of drug release rates, enabling customized
therapeutic profiles and reduced dosing frequency for improved patient convenience.

Patient-Friendly Design

Nualtis films dissolve rapidly in the mouth without water, making medication administration easier.
They are easy to carry, discreet, with a pleasant taste. Especially for pediatric patients,
geriatric populations, animals, and those with swallowing difficulties the convenient format
improves treatment adherence.

## Our **product platforms** redefine patient outcomes

At Nualtis, we have been pioneering oral film technologies for over two decades. With unmatched
depth in formulation expertise, Nualtis has emerged as a market leader in oral film development with
over 30 patents just in the US.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

# To be the leader in innovative drug delivery solutions that transform patient experiences through
# improved convenience and better treatment adherence.

**Making Quality Healthcare Affordable Through Drug Delivery Solutions Focusing On Patient
Convenience and Adherence**

Zim Innovation
Who we are
What we do
How we help you

# An Innovative Pharmaceutical Manufacturer in India

We are a research-driven pharmaceutical company based in India that develops, manufactures, and
supplies differentiated generic products in the oral solid dosage forms, both as pre-formulation
intermediates as well as finished formulations for certain key therapeutic segments. As a vertically
integrated pharmaceutical manufacturer, we offer both pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products.

We have in-house R&D capabilities to offer a range of non-infringing drug delivery solutions based
on process technologies that enable patient compliance thereby reducing the cost of treatment.

[
Know More
[Know More]][72]

# We develop complex generic products & novel drug delivery techniques

We provide a comprehensive range of solutions in India and across the globe from a pharmaceutical
manufacturer, including product conceptualization, development, BE studies, regulatory support for
dossier preparation and submission, product registrations, manufacturing, and supply.

Our offerings encompass differentiated generic products in the form of finished formulations and
pre-formulation intermediates, such as granules, pellets (immediate-release, modified-release,
delayed-release, etc.), taste-masked powders, dry suspensions, tablets, capsules, and Oral Thin
Films (OTF).

[
Know More
[Know More]][73]

# We help our partners gain market-share with our cutting-edge technology

As an experienced pharmaceutical manufacturer,  ZIM Labs uses its proprietary knowledge, technology
and manufacturing process expertise to bridge the technology gap in Regulated, Pharmerging and ROW
markets while assisting local players in various geographies to launch differentiated /combination
generic products to compete in their respective local markets.

Know More
[Know More]][74]

We are a pharmaceutical products manufacturing company, innovating in novel drug delivery solutions,
leveraging cutting-edge technology to deliver maximum benefits to our clients. Backed by an expert
R&D team and state-of-the-art facilities, our vision is to provide niche, affordable, and
high-quality healthcare solutions that ensure patient convenience and adherence.

# Burn Fat.
# Build Muscle.

Experience the strength & cardio workout that delivers results that you can see and feel from the
inside out.

FSA/HSA eligible

## The workout that works out well.

Orangetheory combines full-body strength training with heart-pumping cardio to help you build
strength now, while laying the foundation for long-term health.

In weeks, most members notice the shift: more energy, a better mood, and real momentum. On average,
members lose **8.6% body fat** and gain **2.6% lean muscle** from 18 classes in just 8 weeks.¹ That
kind of progress is why millions of members across 1,500 studios worldwide have chosen Orangetheory
to achieve their fitness goals.

Not your thing after 30 days? No sweat—we’ll refund your money.^{†}

[Woman running on a treadmill.]
[Woman doing a low row with a dumbbell, guided by a coach.]

## More personalized. Less pressure.

You don’t need to be fit to get started. Just show up—we’ve got you. With expert coaching and
OTconnect™ technology, every workout adjusts to your fitness level and your goals. Whether you’re
easing in or pushing hard, we meet you with encouragement and support—not pressure. Every step
forward builds a body—and mindset—that’s stronger than yesterday.

[Learn more about the workout.][39]

## The workout that works for people like you.

OTF has really kept me on track as part of my daily routine. It's one of the best decisions I have
made for myself.

[Brad G.]
Brad G
OTF Midland

I feel encouraged and not intimidated by the coaches, and thanks to the OTconnect performance
monitor, I can go at my own pace and do what works for me.

[Nicole P.]
Nicole P
OTF Waterford

My initial goal was to get moving and increase my energy levels. In the process, I have lost over 20
pounds, lost inches, built muscles, and feel stronger than ever!

[Max D.]
Max D
OTF Royal Palm Beach

**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

## Start small.
## Learn fast.

### Can I start with a 500-box pilot run?

Yes. Qualified projects can begin with a 500-box pilot, depending on the formula, strip count,
packaging, and production setup. The goal is to validate the product before committing to scale.

### How many strips does that mean?

Five hundred 20-count boxes equal 10,000 strips. Five hundred 30-count boxes equal 15,000 strips. We
show both box and strip quantities in the project brief so the first run is easy to picture.

### Private label or custom?

Private label is the faster route when a proven concept fits. Custom development makes sense when
the active, dose, flavor, or product experience needs to be unique.

### What happens after I send a project brief?

We review formula feasibility, target box count, packaging, testing, timing, and the most practical
route to a qualified pilot run.

### What are oral dissolving films also called?

Depending on intended use, buyers may use oral dissolving film (ODF), oral thin film (OTF),
mouth-dissolving strip, fast-dissolving strip, sublingual film, buccal film, melt-in-mouth strip, or
orally disintegrating film. The intended route and product claims must be confirmed for each
project.

### Is an oral film manufacturer the same as an OEM, CMO, or CDMO?

OEM, CMO, and CDMO describe different possible development and manufacturing scopes. StripWorks
supports brand-owned private-label and custom contract manufacturing projects, with formulation,
testing, packaging, documentation, and regulatory responsibilities confirmed in writing for each
project.

the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

Who can apply?

What product lines are available?

Can I sell under my own brand?

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
